title: In 2024, 28% of people lived where population had already peaked
body: The UN's 2024 estimates put 63 countries and areas in this group, including China and Japan. They held 28% of the global population that year even though the world total was still increasing.
takeaway: A growing world total can conceal very different trajectories for the places within it.
visual: neighbours walking through a quiet residential area in a Japanese city

title: A single survey in India used 17 interview languages
body: For a report published in 2021, Pew Research Center conducted nearly 30,000 face-to-face interviews with adults in India. The questionnaires were delivered in 17 languages across the study.
takeaway: Multiple interview languages let a survey reach people who would be left out if it relied on just one.
source: Pew Research Center, Religion in India: Tolerance and Segregation (2021)
visual: an interviewer and a participant talking at a shaded table
